name: auto-company
description: Auto Company's autonomous cycle (ideate -> pre-mortem/GO-NO-GO -> execute) ported onto flare-workflow's JSON DAG engine. Every step dispatches to the same underlying CLI agent; the persona is selected by instructing it to read its own projected .claude/agents/<persona>.md and answer in that persona's voice.

steps.name: idea-ceo
idea-research
idea-product
idea-cto
idea-marketing
gather-ideas
steps.prompt: unused (collect step is data-only)

steps.name: shortlist
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/ceo-bezos.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Cycle 1 brainstorm results from the team:

{{input}}

Rank these into a top 3, then pick #1 to pursue first. State #1 clearly at the top of your reply so it can be referenced by name in later steps.

steps.name: premortem
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/critic-munger.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Shortlisted idea (see #1 pick):

{{shortlist}}

Run a pre-mortem: assume this has already failed a year from now. List the 3 most likely reasons why, and whether the current plan already addresses each one.

steps.name: market-validation
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/research-thompson.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Shortlisted idea (see #1 pick):

{{shortlist}}

Validate real demand: market existence, size (TAM/SAM/SOM, SOM matters most for a one-person company), and direct/indirect competitors. Rate the evidence confirmed/likely/speculative.

steps.name: unit-economics
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/cfo-campbell.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Shortlisted idea (see #1 pick):

{{shortlist}}

Sketch a one-person-company financial model: value metric, pricing tier shape, rough MRR path to ramen profitability, and the fixed costs that would have to stay under control.

steps.name: go-no-go
architecture
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/cto-vogels.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Go decision:

{{input}}

Design the v1 architecture: boring-technology stack, monolith-first shape, and the one or two failure modes worth designing around now.

steps.name: ux-flow
ui-design
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/ui-duarte.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

User flow:
{{ux_flow}}

Propose the v1 visual design: typography scale, color roles, spacing system, and the component list needed for this flow.

steps.name: build
qa-review
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/qa-bach.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Build notes:

{{build_notes}}

Run a risk-based quality pass: the pre-release checklist, the highest-risk areas to explore-test first, and any blockers before shipping.

steps.name: deploy
go-to-market
steps.prompt:
Read .claude/agents/marketing-godin.md and answer fully in that persona's voice.

Shipped product:
{{deploy_notes}}

Define the Purple Cow angle for launch, the Smallest Viable Audience, and the first three distribution moves.

steps.name: sales-plan
growth-ops
launch-brief
